responsibilities: Engineered an LLM-powered support assistant integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to retrieve platform policies and medical video metadata and fetch real-time event information, generating context-grounded response suggestions for doctor-support queries.

Implemented semantic response caching using Redis and embedding-based similarity search, targeting a 40–50% reduction in redundant LLM API calls and improved response latency for recurring support and content queries.
Developed a centralized customer communication dashboard integrating the WhatsApp Business Platform and Microsoft Outlook, unifying support communications and message tracking across both channels.

Implemented webhook-driven message status synchronization for WhatsApp and Outlook email workflows, processing message lifecycle events and updating relational database records to maintain consistent delivery-status tracking.

Automated thumbnail generation and AI-powered synopsis extraction for 500+ medical video assets, streamlining content preparation and enriching platform metadata with reusable media assets and structured summaries.
Automated salary-slip generation and distribution, streamlining recurring payroll cycles and reducing manual document preparation and distribution effort.
